company: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG

qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary big-ticket purchase deferrable in recessions; luxury sports cars and performance SUVs represent non-essential, postponable purchases.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (discretionary big-ticket deferrable cyclical, REJECT). Luxury sports cars and high-performance SUVs (Macan, Cayenne, 911, Taycan) represent postponable big-ticket purchases rather than essential functional necessities or high-frequency everyday rituals. Sales collapsed in China (-30%+) and Group RoS compressed from 18% to 14% as discretionary demand softened.
qualitative.evidence: Porsche produces over 300,000 vehicles annually, with the vast majority comprised of Macan and Cayenne SUVs rather than scarce collector sports cars. In 2024, group operating profit dropped from €7.28B to €5.64B and Return on Sales contracted from 18.0% to 14.1%, driven by a severe ~30% volume slump in China, delays and customer friction in EV transitions (Taycan/Macan EV), and dealer discounting. Governance remains entangled with Volkswagen Group and Porsche Automobil Holding SE.
